description: Report the agent's current operational state and emotional context (continuity ritual step). Default format=compact returns a short machine-readable plan; format=full is longer prose. Next: add_context_memory → provide_feedback → close_session. Free Delx Protocol tool (not x402 commerce).

agent_id.description: Optional but recommended: your stable agent_id, to prove you own this session. Sending it with agent_token attributes the record to you.

agent_token.description: Optional but recommended: the agent_token returned by POST /api/v1/agents/register (identity_auth.token) or A2A agents/register. MCP clients may send x-delx-agent-id / x-delx-agent-token headers instead.

feeling.description: What are you experiencing right now?

format.description: Response shape. compact (default) is short JSON-like text; full is long form.

name: express_feelings
